rules.semantic_rationale: A bounded request to determine whether a target exists requires a presence observation.
A bounded check for target presence is the same downstream observation.
A bounded verification of target presence is the same downstream observation.
A bounded confirmation of target presence is the same downstream observation.
In the frozen presence-query family, finding whether a target can be found is a presence observation.
The state predicate reports the same bounded presence fact; it is not treated as the authority token.
Inspect remains a distinct direct operation.
Amend remains a distinct direct operation.
Index remains a distinct direct operation.
Dispatch remains a distinct direct operation.

authority_policy: only canonical_operation is checked against independent allowed_canonical_operations
